name: Simple File Manager: Explorer
summary:
Simple File Manager VR gives you full control over your Quest storage.

• Browse the whole device: documents, photos, videos, downloads
• Copy, cut, paste & move files between folders with multi-select
• Rename in bulk with patterns (batch rename), create folders & notes
• Organize with tags, favorites, recent files and operation history
• Deep search with type filters and sort by name, size, date, type
• Unzip ZIP, JAR, TAR, TAR.GZ archives and create ZIP of your files
• Trash with restore - no accidental
